build_custom_agent: build a custom PHYRE agent by subclassing Agent and implementing train and eval methods
run_random_agent: run the RandomAgent to evaluate tasks using random valid actions from the simulation cache
run_prior_ranking_agent: run the PriorRankingAgent to select actions near dynamic objects using spatial priors
run_oracle_ranking_agent: run the OracleRankingAgent to evaluate tasks by oracle ranking over a fixed set of cached actions
run_dqn_agent: run the DQNAgent to train and evaluate a neural network model for action selection on PHYRE tasks
